data.title: Coalition: Two UAVs Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia Intercepted, Destroyed in Riyadh and Southern Regions
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that two UAVs launched by the terrorist Houthi militia were intercepted and destroyed in Riyadh and southern regions.
    -- SPA
10:22 Local Time 07:22 GMT
